name: Marci 6 Elves / 4 Monk
description: A three-star Marci carry backed by 6 Elves for evasion and 2 Wizards to unlock the elf bonus early, with Monks to trigger Marci's execute passive. Sourced from the YouTube guide 'HOW TO PLAY Marci 6/9 Elves RAMPAGE Build In Auto Chess'.

snapshots.label: Final board
snapshots.focusNote: 5 elves + 2 wizards (Dark Willow counts as both) trip the 6-Elf 40% evasion tier. Marci sits back-corner-adjacent, blinks to the enemy backline, and her Monk passive executes low-health targets. Treant/Furion summons stall while she cleans up.
